issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 65,318 (Special Revenue - Keno column)
issues.issue: Category comes from the fund name, not the row label. The row is a generic 'Local Receipts: Other'. Under the fund-name rule this is defensible for a Keno fund, but the 2026-11-12 ruling keeps context labels as other unless the page supports the category. The same applies to detail[22].
The enterprise funds' only revenue is almost certainly utility charges, but the page does not say so. 'other' is kept under the context-label rule. Same for detail[23], detail[25] and detail[29].

Function inferred from the fund column, not printed on the row. The same applies to disbursements[4] 'Capital Outlay: Utilities' (Water column of 'Capital Improvements') and to detail[19] and detail[26]. The 2026-11-12 ruling says to add a function only when it is printed.

The label is plain 'Community Development', not 'Community development/betterment', and it sits in a Housing capital projects fund. Economic development or housing are also defensible. Same for detail[21].

County Treasurer balances printed below the statement are left out as informational. They are not part of line 26 Net Cash Balance, so they are correctly excluded from the totals. Noted only for awareness.
